lesson.subtitle: Lesson 2 -- It Doesn't Work
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Diogo Campos Silva | Lesson 2 -- It Doesn't Work
lesson.grammar_point: present simple negative and questions (don't / doesn't, do / does)

listenings.text: Hi Diogo, this is Paula from Finance. I have a problem with my email. I don't receive messages, and I don't see my folders. My password is correct, but the screen shows an error. The bank website doesn't open in my browser too. Please call me back. Thank you.

Hello, this is Ravi from support. I have three questions about your ticket. Does the error appear on every computer, or only on one? Do the users see the website on their phones? And does the problem start in the morning? Please write the answers in the ticket. Thank you.

extra_audio.text: Paula works in Finance. Her email doesn't work today. She calls Diogo. Diogo asks: Does the screen show an error? Paula says: Yes, it does. It says: connection failed.

vocab.title: Match each word to its meaning
defs: a page or pages on the internet
the part of the computer or phone you look at
a person who uses a computer or a system
the program you use to open websites
a secret word you type to enter a system
a message that says something is wrong

paras: Paula works in Finance. She is a user of the company email. Today, her email doesn't work. She doesn't receive messages, and she doesn't see her folders.
Her password is correct. But when she opens the email, the screen shows an error: "Connection failed." The bank website doesn't open in her browser too. Other users don't have this problem.
Diogo, the IT analyst, reads the ticket. He doesn't know the cause yet. He writes a question to the vendor: "Does this error appear on other computers? Do you see a problem on your side?"
